approval_record: Approved in the working session on 2026-09-19: the owner asked for the YouTube connector to be live-verified and for a new Google Cloud project to be created for it rather than reusing an existing one. Two checks against YouTube's own material: the platform's official channel (UCBR8-60-B28hp2BmDPdntcQ), one page of uploads; and top-level comment threads on jNQXAC9IVRw, the first video published on YouTube. Each check reads two pages, because the connector spends its first page on the channel or video itself and returns items on the next one: four requests in total, about four units of the free 10,000/day Data API quota, no billing and no paid request. A first attempt on the same day bounded both checks to one page and therefore returned no items; the bound was corrected and the checks re-run. The API key is read from TRACEHOLLOW_LIVE_YOUTUBE_API_KEY, sent once to the isolated live-check project, and never written to results or logs.
